name: encoding-reflection-strict-decoder
description: A decoding call the program makes refuse a document that names a member the type lacks reads every field it decodes, written or not, because deleting a field makes it refuse a document that names that field. The call is strict where the decoder it runs through took one of its package's strict switches: a YAML decoder's KnownFields with the constant true, here inside a function of the program that hands its parameter on, a JSON decoder's DisallowUnknownFields, the DisallowUnknownFields option of sigs.k8s.io/yaml, the DisallowUnknownField option a goccy YAML decoder is made with, an encoding/json/v2 RejectUnknownMembers option given a flag the command computes, a YAML v2 decoder's SetStrict reached through a method value, and a go.yaml.in YAML v2 decoder's SetStrict called as a method expression, whose flag follows the decoder. A switch taking a flag enables unless the flag is the constant false, because a flag known only when the program runs may be true. A strict decoder skips a field its tag gives the key `-`, which it never decodes. A decoder with no such switch, a YAML decoder whose KnownFields takes false and a second decoder of the same package that takes no switch fill the fields and read none, so a field one of them alone fills and nothing reads is reported, at the reachability class possible where the decoder is outside the analyzed program.
